assertions.sql: SELECT c.name AS kunde, p.name AS produkt, o.quantity FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE c.city = 'Aarhus' ORDER BY c.name, p.name
SELECT p.category, COUNT(*)::int AS antal_ordrelinjer FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category
